preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, K and N must be between 1 and 100,000, and K must not exceed N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 1000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(A[i] == A[N - i - 1] for i in range(N // 2))
postconditions.description: If the array can be made palindromic, the output must be 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: not any(A[i] != A[N - i - 1] for i in range(N // 2))
postconditions.description: If the array cannot be made palindromic, the output must be 'NO'.
